title: [GMCP 203.009.M] Mastery: Complete tool server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-009-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Tool discovery, deterministic pagination/filtering, list-change signaling, invocation, structured and unstructured results, output-schema validation, annotations, icons, errors, cancellation, progress, caching, idempotency declarations, and concurrent execution all work through the production registry. Tool identity and schema changes are versioned, calls are policy-gated, and success is impossible when declared output contracts are violated. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
